turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: This is my first real interview ever, for a summer internship. What should I bring?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Bring a couple of printed copies of your resume, a notebook and a pen. And a few questions you want to ask.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on a sec, do I need a portfolio or anything?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Only if the role is creative or technical. A class project you're proud of can be a good thing to show.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I built a small app for a class

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's still worth mentioning. Explain what problem it solved and what you learned building it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. How early should I show up?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: About ten minutes early is perfect. Earlier than that, wait outside so you don't rush their schedule.
